description: Opinionated MongoDB application toolkit for .NET: validated multi-cluster DI, tenant-aware namespaces, document policies, typed repositories, provisioning and transactions on top of MongoDB.Driver.
rules: Reference Dilcore.MongoDB for an application host. Use Dilcore.MongoDB.Abstractions only in libraries that need contracts without DI.
Version 2 is in preview. Install with dotnet add package Dilcore.MongoDB --prerelease and keep all Dilcore.MongoDB packages on the same version.
If an app needs one MongoClient and a few collection calls, use MongoDB.Driver directly instead of this toolkit.
Call AddMongoDb once. Do not create MongoClient instances yourself; the toolkit shares one client per unique cluster settings.
Repository methods return FluentResults Result values. Check IsFailed or HasError<TError>() and map typed errors such as DocumentNotFoundError, ConcurrencyConflictError and DuplicateKeyError.
Namespace prefix resolvers must fail closed: return Result.Fail when the tenant is unknown, never an empty prefix.
Create indexes with IMongoDbProvisioner at startup or in a deploy job, not in request handlers. Name every index.
Transactions need a replica set. Resolve repositories from IMongoDbTransactionContext.Repositories inside the callback, not from the request scope.
AddSystemTextJsonDocuments and AddNewtonsoftJsonDocuments must be called after AddMongoDb. Never add the Newtonsoft package to a System.Text.Json-only app.
OpenTelemetry instrumentation, vector search and streaming redesign are planned and not in the packages yet.
